The structure of NbCr3O8 crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with a unit cell containing 24 atoms and seven independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Cr and Nb centers as octahedral, each coordinated by six O neighbors, while O environments include square pyramidal and five-vertex coordination. Corner-sharing is observed between Cr–Cr, Cr–Nb, and Nb–Nb octahedra, and corner-sharing also links square pyramidal O polyhedra to Cr and Nb octahedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 24 sites.
